key_findings.module_absent: No account_deferred standalone module in Odoo 19 Community
key_findings.model_absent: No account.deferred ORM model class exists in Community source
key_findings.automation_absent: No amortization schedule computation or automated periodic journal entry generation in Community
key_findings.account_types: account/models/account_account.py lines 44-70 — account_type selection has no dedicated deferred revenue or deferred expense types; closest are asset_current, asset_prepayments, liability_current
key_findings.test_only_reference: account/tests/common.py lines 365-372 — only reference to deferred account slots is in test helper setup using generic account types as placeholders for payment method configuration
key_findings.enterprise_gap: Full deferred revenue/expense management with amortization schedules and automated periodic entries is Enterprise-only in Odoo 19
